item.title: [MEDIUM] CVE-2026-66401: FreeRDP before 3.29.0 contains an out-of-bounds heap read vulnerability in the U...
item.description: FreeRDP before 3.29.0 contains an out-of-bounds heap read vulnerability in the UVC H.264 extension-unit parser that fails to validate descriptor length before accessing the GUID field.
